name: language-distiller
description: Distill language-course material (course books, lecture slides, handouts, notes) into compact study sheets (vocabulary, grammar, useful phrases and a catchy story that reuses the lesson), written in your own words, then into an offline phone study app with neural voices that repeat on tap, an examples-only listening mode that keeps playing with the screen off, one-tap spaced-repetition flashcards, five lesson games and MP3 listening episodes. German is the reference language; others get a language profile.
